description.fr-FR: Le traité écrit vers 1685 pour la duchesse de Beauvillier, suivi de l’Avis à une dame de qualité sur l’éducation de sa fille : la formation de l’enfant par la douceur, l’exemple et les récits, l’instruction religieuse, la vanité, les devoirs des femmes et le choix des gouvernantes. L’anglais est la traduction de Thomas Frognall Dibdin (1805), qui suit les treize chapitres.
description.en-US: The treatise written about 1685 for the Duchess of Beauvillier, followed by the Advice to a Lady of Quality on the education of her daughter: forming the child by gentleness, example and stories, religious instruction, vanity, the duties of women and the choice of governesses. The English is Thomas Frognall Dibdin’s translation of 1805, which follows the thirteen chapters (it lacks the Advice).
description.pt-BR: O tratado escrito por volta de 1685 para a duquesa de Beauvillier, seguido do Aviso a uma dama de qualidade sobre a educação de sua filha: a formação da criança pela doçura, o exemplo e as histórias, a instrução religiosa, a vaidade, os deveres das mulheres e a escolha das governantas.

sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
